notes.title: Update 3.2.4 - new zoom feature + improvements
notes.notes:
[b]You can now zoom out the view using CTRL + SCROLL WHEEL.[/b]

It is now possible to see much more of the work area than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37294984/2af48d1ec66ed8714b6f0c7d51ff6802bdc4d088.png[/img]

It is still recommended to reset the view when editing nodes by pressing the circular arrow icon in the top-right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37294984/4005412cb14968445a52b51e5ea23ae353eed363.png[/img]


[b]Additionaly, scrolling is now much smoother (hold SHIFT when scrolling to pan the view horizontally).[/b]


The update is live now so go check it out!
